en.headline: Fukuoka yatai restaurant Ganso Hakata Yatai opens at One Causeway Bay
en.dek: The first overseas outpost of Yatai Keiji brings charcoal-grilled yakitori, robatayaki and ramen to a 106-seat venue overlooking the typhoon shelter.
body: Ganso Hakata Yatai by Yataikeiji has opened at Shop 210 of One Causeway Bay on Gloucester Road, marking the first overseas branch of the Fukuoka-based Yatai Keiji, founded in 1991.

The 2,500-square-foot restaurant, a partnership between Yuta Abe and local hospitality group CSC Collective, seats 106 diners and features two yatai-style counters plus a private dining room. The menu includes charcoal-grilled yakitori, robatayaki, oden, akashiyaki and ramen prepared by Japanese chefs.
Daily hours are 12:00 to 14:30 for lunch and 17:30 to 23:00 for dinner. The venue overlooks the Causeway Bay Typhoon Shelter on the site of the former Excelsior Hotel.
Organisers said the concept aims to bring the convivial street-food atmosphere of Fukuoka’s yatai culture to Hong Kong diners.

zh.headline: 福岡屋台「元祖博多屋台」進駐銅鑼灣港島壹號中心
zh.dek: 屋台けいじ首家海外分店在告士打道281號開業，設106個座位，供應炭火燒鳥、爐端燒及拉麵等福岡風味。
body: 元祖博多屋台（Ganso Hakata Yatai by Yataikeiji）已於銅鑼灣告士打道281號港島壹號中心210號舖開業，是福岡「屋台けいじ」的首家海外分店。
餐廳佔地約2500平方呎，由創辦人安部雄太與本地餐飲集團CSC Collective合作，設106個座位，包括兩間屋台風格吧架及一間私人貴峓室。菜單由日本廚師主理，涵蓋炭火燒鳥、爐端燒、關東煮、明石燒及拉麵。
每日午市由中午12時至下午2時30分，晚市由下午5時30分至晚上11時。餐廳俯瞰銅鑼灣避風塘，位於前怡東酒店舊址。
主辦方表示，希望將福岡屋台熱鬧的街頭飲食文化帶到香港。
